key: I'll kick that smirk right off of your face!
en: I'll kick that smirk right off of your face!
ja: そのニヤけ面、蹴り飛ばしてやる!

key: I'll just go back to training now.
en: I'll just go back to training now.
ja: もう、トレーニングに戻るとするか。

key: I must learn to control my competitiveness and aggression.
en: I must learn to control my competitiveness and aggression.
ja: 自分の負けん気と攻撃性を、抑える術を学ばなくちゃな。

key: You're cordially invited, noob!
en: You're cordially invited, noob!
ja: 光栄に思えよ、初心者!

key: Well that was a royal kick in the butt- butt.
en: Well that was a royal kick in the butt- butt.
ja: いやー、見事にケツを蹴っ飛ばされたわ――ケツを。

key: Okay, after seeing you battle, I wanna say this: Damn girl, you is a PIMP.
en: Okay, after seeing you battle, I wanna say this: Damn girl, you is a PIMP.
ja: よし、あんたの戦いを見て、これだけは言わせて。マジ、あんたイケてるわ。

key: I can sense each step you'll take before you even move.
en: I can sense each step you'll take before you even move.
ja: あんたが動く前から、次の一手が分かるんだよ。

key: Take this-- hyaaah!
en: Take this-- hyaaah!
ja: くらえ――やあああっ!

key: My willpower is superior! HAAAH!
en: My willpower is superior! HAAAH!
ja: 俺の意志の力の方が上だ! ハアアッ!

key: Look at these guys! Maybe I'll become as strong as them, too. Starting with you!
en: Look at these guys! Maybe I'll become as strong as them, too. Starting with you!
ja: こいつらを見ろよ! 俺もこんなふうに強くなれるかもな。まずはお前からだ!

key: Well, that dream was short-lived.
en: Well, that dream was short-lived.
ja: はは、夢は短かったな。

key: Hrm. I'll just stick to fighting the weary mountain trails.
en: Hrm. I'll just stick to fighting the weary mountain trails.
ja: うーむ。俺はやっぱり、疲れた山道と戦うのが性に合ってるみたいだ。

key: Remember, remember...
en: Remember, remember...
ja: 思い出せ、思い出すんだ……

key: What was in that lecture?
en: What was in that lecture?
ja: あの講義、何て言ってたっけ?

key: "When you strike the stone, it is not the force of the fist that breaks the rock, but the force of your will."
en: "When you strike the stone, it is not the force of the fist that breaks the rock, but the force of your will."
ja: 「石を打つとき、岩を砕くのはこぶしの力ではなく、意志の力である」

key: Something like that, right?
en: Something like that, right?
ja: こんな感じだったよな?

key: "Strength is not relative to those around you. It is an absolute force inside yourself, driving you through life."
en: "Strength is not relative to those around you. It is an absolute force inside yourself, driving you through life."
ja: 「強さとは、周囲との比較ではない。それは己の内にある絶対的な力であり、人生を突き動かすものである」

key: What does that mean? I still don't understand.
en: What does that mean? I still don't understand.
ja: それってどういう意味なんだ? いまだによく分からん。

key: KIKI: Greetings.
en: KIKI: Greetings.
ja: キキ: ようこそ。

key: Are you a new student?
en: Are you a new student?
ja: 新しい生徒さんですか?

key: I see. Welcome.
en: I see. Welcome.
ja: なるほど。ようこそ。

key: Please, have a seat.
en: Please, have a seat.
ja: どうぞ、お座りください。

key: KIKI: Now, for today's lecture.
en: KIKI: Now, for today's lecture.
ja: キキ: では、今日の講義に入ります。

key: We will be reviewing the final principle for this curriculum, the art of void.
en: We will be reviewing the final principle for this curriculum, the art of void.
ja: このカリキュラム最後の教え、「無の術」を復習しましょう。

key: Void is the acknowledgement of that which cannot be known.
en: Void is the acknowledgement of that which cannot be known.
ja: 無とは、知り得ぬものを認めることです。

key: It is the understanding that all ideas are in themselves fallible.
en: It is the understanding that all ideas are in themselves fallible.
ja: あらゆる考えは、それ自体が誤りうるという理解でもあります。

key: For that reason, this principle cannot be taught; only considered.
en: For that reason, this principle cannot be taught; only considered.
ja: それゆえ、この教えは教えることができません。ただ、考えることしかできないのです。

key: Many people believe that some things are "right" and "correct" and others are not.
en: Many people believe that some things are "right" and "correct" and others are not.
ja: 多くの人は、あるものは「正しく」「正解」で、あるものはそうでないと信じています。

key: But these are not the laws of the world.
en: But these are not the laws of the world.
ja: しかし、それは世界の法則ではありません。

key: Concepts such as "virtues" or "evil" must not be given way to exist, for this is not the true void.
en: Concepts such as "virtues" or "evil" must not be given way to exist, for this is not the true void.
ja: 「善」や「悪」といった概念に、存在の余地を与えてはなりません。それは真の無ではないからです。

key: By perceiving that which exists, learn to perceive that which does not.
en: By perceiving that which exists, learn to perceive that which does not.
ja: 存在するものを知覚することによって、存在しないものを知覚することを学びなさい。

key: All things, even this instruction, must be questioned.
en: All things, even this instruction, must be questioned.
ja: あらゆるものは、この教え自体も含めて、疑われなければなりません。

key: Thank you.
en: Thank you.
ja: 礼を言う

key: Just a visitor then?
en: Just a visitor then?
ja: では、見学だけですか?

key: KIKI: Hello again.
en: KIKI: Hello again.
ja: キキ: またお会いしましたね。

key: Please allow me now to formally welcome you as a student of Apophyll Academy.
en: Please allow me now to formally welcome you as a student of Apophyll Academy.
ja: あらためて、アポフィルアカデミーの生徒として、あなたを正式に迎え入れさせてください。

key: We are honored to have earned your faith, and I look forward to observing your diligence and growth in the coming weeks.
en: We are honored to have earned your faith, and I look forward to observing your diligence and growth in the coming weeks.
ja: あなたの信頼を得られたこと、光栄に思います。これからの日々、あなたの努力と成長を見守れることを楽しみにしています。

key: I'll assign you a dormitory and schedule as soon as we return to the Academy.
en: I'll assign you a dormitory and schedule as soon as we return to the Academy.
ja: アカデミーに戻り次第、寮と予定表を割り当てますね。

key: Or was there something you required me for?
en: Or was there something you required me for?
ja: それとも、何か私にご用でしたか?
……あら?

key: There is a threat to Apophyll?
en: There is a threat to Apophyll?
ja: アポフィルに脅威が迫っているのですか?

key: This sounds quite serious.
en: This sounds quite serious.
ja: それは、かなり深刻なようですね。

key: And the Machine Strength...
en: And the Machine Strength...
ja: それに、かいりきマシンも……

key: Yes, we should have it.
en: Yes, we should have it.
ja: ええ、こちらにあるはずです。

key: But it sounds like there is much to discuss.
en: But it sounds like there is much to discuss.
ja: でも、話すべきことが多そうですね。

key: Everything in due time.
en: Everything in due time.
ja: すべては、しかるべき時に。

key: For now, please meet me in my room at the Academy, and we will officially enroll you.
en: For now, please meet me in my room at the Academy, and we will officially enroll you.
ja: 今は、アカデミーの私の部屋で会いましょう。そこで正式に入学の手続きをします。

key: It is the furthest back from the main entrance.
en: It is the furthest back from the main entrance.
ja: 正面玄関から見て、一番奥の部屋です。

key: Allow me to finish my lecture, and then let us speak at length in my room at the Academy.
en: Allow me to finish my lecture, and then let us speak at length in my room at the Academy.
ja: 講義を終えたら、アカデミーの私の部屋でじっくり話しましょう。

key: We will see what can be done.
en: We will see what can be done.
ja: できることを考えましょう。

key: I used to go to the Onyx Trainers' School, but the classes there were so boring!
en: I used to go to the Onyx Trainers' School, but the classes there were so boring!
ja: 前はオニキストレーナー学校に通ってたんだけど、授業がめちゃくちゃ退くつだったの!

key: Kiki's lectures aren't boring at all. They're short, sweet, and totally relevant.
en: Kiki's lectures aren't boring at all. They're short, sweet, and totally relevant.
ja: キキ先生の講義は全然退くつじゃないよ。短くて、分かりやすくて、実用的なんだ。

key: I mean, who needs to know trigonometry anyway?
en: I mean, who needs to know trigonometry anyway?
ja: だって、三角関数なんて誰が必要とするわけ?

key: Shh, I won't be able to hear!
en: Shh, I won't be able to hear!
ja: しー、聞こえなくなっちゃう!

key: Emblazen me with your knowledge! I will become the power of words!
en: Emblazen me with your knowledge! I will become the power of words!
ja: その知識で、僕を照らしてください! 僕は言葉の力になります!

key: Hey, down in front, I'm trying to see!
en: Hey, down in front, I'm trying to see!
ja: ちょっと、前かがんでよ、見えないんだけど!

key: I may come here just to fish, but I never miss a chance to attend Kiki's lecture.
en: I may come here just to fish, but I never miss a chance to attend Kiki's lecture.
ja: 釣りをしに来てるだけだけど、キキ先生の講義は絶対に見逃さないんだ。

key: Long walks and long talks.
en: Long walks and long talks.
ja: 長い散歩と、長いおしゃべり。

key: That's what I'm about.
en: That's what I'm about.
ja: それが俺の生き方さ。

key: Oh, are you a new student?
en: Oh, are you a new student?
ja: あら、新しい生徒さん?

key: Well, go on, take a seat.
en: Well, go on, take a seat.
ja: さあさあ、座って。

key: Kiki's full of wisdom!
en: Kiki's full of wisdom!
ja: キキ先生は知恵の宝庫だよ!

key: Someday I'll be as smart as her!
en: Someday I'll be as smart as her!
ja: いつか先生みたいに賢くなるんだ!

key: Hrm. Have a seat, listen well.
en: Hrm. Have a seat, listen well.
ja: うーむ。座って、よく聞くといい。

key: I don't always get what she's talking about... but it sounds deep.
en: I don't always get what she's talking about... but it sounds deep.
ja: 先生の話、いつも分かるわけじゃないけど……なんか深いんだよね。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
